senses.en: feeling or showing great joy and pride, especially after a success

example.en: The exultant crowd celebrated the team's victory.
example.zh: 欢欣鼓舞的人群庆祝球队的胜利。

senses.en: an early experience or sample of something that is to come

example.en: The warm weekend gave us a foretaste of summer.
example.zh: 这个温暖的周末让我们提前感受到了夏天的气息。

collocations: a foretaste of things to come

senses.en: an expert in diet and nutrition

example.en: The dietician designed a healthy meal plan for the patient.
example.zh: 营养师为病人设计了一份健康饮食计划。

senses.en: a business owned by one person who bears the liabilities and receives the profits

example.en: She runs her bakery as a sole proprietorship.
example.zh: 她以独资企业的形式经营她的面包店。

senses.en: to give someone an anesthetic so they do not feel pain (British spelling)

example.en: The patient was anaesthetized before the operation.
example.zh: 病人在手术前接受了麻醉。

senses.en: a title used before a man's name

example.en: Mr Smith is our new teacher.
example.zh: 史密斯先生是我们的新老师。

senses.en: growing thickly and in great abundance

example.en: The valley is covered in lush green grass.
example.zh: 山谷里长满了茂盛的青草。

senses.en: luxuriously rich or appealing to the senses
senses.zh: 豪华舒适的；感官享受强烈的

example.en: The hotel lobby had lush red carpets and velvet chairs.
example.zh: 酒店大堂铺着奢华的红色地毯，摆着天鹅绒座椅。

senses.en: to say something is bigger, better or worse than it really is; to exaggerate

example.en: Don't overstate the problem—it's really quite small.
example.zh: 不要夸大这个问题——它其实很小。

senses.en: an aircraft that flies without a pilot, controlled remotely

example.en: The drone captured aerial photos of the valley.
example.zh: 无人机拍摄了山谷的航拍照片。

senses.en: a male bee whose only role is to mate with the queen

example.en: Drones do not gather nectar from flowers.
example.zh: 雄蜂不从花中采蜜。

senses.en: to make a low continuous dull sound, or speak in a boring monotone
senses.zh: 嗡嗡作响；单调低沉地说

example.en: The lecturer droned on about economic theory.
example.zh: 讲师单调乏味地继续讲着经济理论。

senses.en: to move a ball with small kicks or bounces, or to flow in drops

example.en: He dribbled the ball past two defenders.
example.zh: 他运球过了两名防守队员。

senses.en: a small amount of liquid in drops; the act of dribbling a ball

example.en: Only a dribble of water came out of the tap.
example.zh: 水龙头里只流出几滴水。

senses.en: a person who fights, especially in a battle or conflict

example.en: The fighters defended the town until help arrived.
example.zh: 战士们守住城镇，直到援军到达。

senses.en: a military aircraft designed to attack other aircraft

example.en: The air force sent two fighters to patrol the border.
example.zh: 空军派出两架战斗机巡逻边境。

senses.en: a person who keeps trying despite difficulties

example.en: She is a fighter who never gives up.
example.zh: 她是个从不放弃的斗士。

senses.en: a customary set of actions performed regularly or on special occasions

example.en: Many cultures have a ritual for welcoming the new year.
example.zh: 许多文化都有迎接新年的仪式。

senses.en: the prescribed procedure for a religious ceremony

example.en: The priest followed the prescribed ritual during the ceremony.
example.zh: 牧师在仪式中遵循规定的程序。

senses.en: relating to or characteristic of religious or social rites

example.en: The dance has ritual significance in the community.
example.zh: 这种舞蹈在社区中具有仪式意义。

senses.en: things that are thrown away; waste material

example.en: Please take out the garbage before you leave.
example.zh: 你离开前请把垃圾拿出去。

senses.en: nonsense; something of very poor quality

example.en: This article is complete garbage.
example.zh: 这篇文章完全是垃圾。

senses.en: a person; a member of the species Homo sapiens

example.en: Every human needs clean water and safe food.
example.zh: 每个人都需要清洁的水和安全的食物。

senses.en: relating to people or their characteristics

example.en: The human body needs sleep to stay healthy.
example.zh: 人体需要睡眠来保持健康。

senses.en: typical of people, including their weaknesses and feelings
senses.zh: 人之常情的；具有人的特点的

example.en: It is human to make mistakes.
example.zh: 犯错误是人之常情。

senses.en: a formal legal process in which a court decides a case

example.en: The case will go to trial next month.
example.zh: 该案件将于下个月开庭审理。

senses.en: a test of performance, quality, or suitability

example.en: The team began a trial of the new software.
example.zh: 团队开始试用这款新软件。

senses.en: a difficult or unpleasant experience

example.en: Moving to a new country was a trial for the family.
example.zh: 搬到新国家对这个家庭来说是一段艰难的考验。

senses.en: at a low speed; not quickly

example.en: The old man walked slowly along the path.
example.zh: 老人沿着小路慢慢地走。

senses.en: gradually over a period of time

example.en: The economy is slowly recovering.
example.zh: 经济正在慢慢复苏。

senses.en: strong and able to endure difficult conditions

example.en: These hardy climbers reached the summit despite the storm.
example.zh: 尽管有暴风雨，这些坚韧的登山者还是登上了顶峰。

senses.en: (of plants) able to survive cold weather or harsh conditions

example.en: This rose is a hardy variety that survives cold winters.
example.zh: 这种玫瑰是耐寒品种，能在寒冷的冬天存活。

senses.en: toward or in a higher position or direction

example.en: The smoke rose slowly upwards into the sky.
example.zh: 烟缓缓向上升入天空。

senses.en: toward a greater amount, number, or age

example.en: Children aged eight and upwards can join the class.
example.zh: 八岁及以上的儿童可以参加这个班。

senses.en: almost certainly; very probably

example.en: He will doubtless arrive late, as usual.
example.zh: 他无疑会像往常一样迟到。

senses.en: an official count of a population

example.en: The national census takes place every ten years.
example.zh: 全国人口普查每十年进行一次。

senses.en: to conduct a census of a population

example.en: Officials census the households every decade.
example.zh: 官员们每十年对住户进行一次普查。

senses.en: to wait hidden, often to attack or do harm

example.en: A cat lurked in the shadows, watching the birds.
example.zh: 一只猫潜伏在阴影里，注视着鸟儿。

senses.en: to read online discussions without posting

example.en: She lurked on the forum for months before posting.
example.zh: 她在论坛里潜水了好几个月才发帖。

senses.en: to exist as an unnoticed threat or presence

example.en: Danger lurks beneath the calm surface.
example.zh: 平静的表面下暗藏危险。

senses.en: knowledge about the natural world based on observation and experiment

example.en: She has always been interested in science, especially biology.
example.zh: 她一直对科学感兴趣，尤其是生物学。

senses.en: a particular branch of study or systematic knowledge

example.en: Economics is a social science that studies how people use resources.
example.zh: 经济学是研究人们如何使用资源的一门社会科学。

senses.en: known by many people

example.en: The Great Wall is famous around the world.
example.zh: 长城闻名于世界。

senses.en: a female given name

example.en: Ruth is my grandmother's name.
example.zh: 露丝是我祖母的名字。

senses.en: pity or compassion for another's suffering (literary, archaic)
senses.zh: 怜悯，同情（文学用法，古旧）

example.en: He looked at the sick bird with ruth.
example.zh: 他满怀怜悯地看着那只生病的鸟。

senses.en: to be present in large numbers in a place and cause damage or nuisance

example.en: Cockroaches infested the old kitchen.
example.zh: 蟑螂大批出没于那间旧厨房。

senses.en: having sex with someone other than your partner

example.en: He admitted he had been unfaithful to his wife.
example.zh: 他承认对妻子不忠。

senses.en: not loyal or true to a duty, promise, or belief

example.en: The official was unfaithful to his duty.
example.zh: 这名官员没有忠于职守。

senses.en: forming or relating to the most exciting or important point of something

example.en: The film ends with a climactic battle scene.
example.zh: 影片以一场作为高潮的战斗场面收尾。

senses.en: being the original or most typical example of its kind

example.en: The giant panda is a prototypical example of a vulnerable species.
example.zh: 大熊猫是易危物种的典型例子。

senses.en: bright blue like a clear sky

example.en: The boat sailed across the azure sea.
example.zh: 小船驶过蔚蓝的大海。

senses.en: the light blue color of a clear sky

example.en: The kite rose into the azure.
example.zh: 风筝飞入了碧空。

senses.en: a device or drug used to prevent pregnancy

example.en: Condoms are a common contraceptive.
example.zh: 安全套是一种常见的避孕用具。

senses.en: preventing pregnancy

example.en: They discussed contraceptive methods with the doctor.
example.zh: 他们和医生讨论了避孕方法。

senses.en: a particular size and style of printed or displayed type

example.en: Choose a clear font for the report.
example.zh: 为报告选择一种清晰的字体。

senses.en: a basin holding water for baptisms in a church

example.en: The baby was baptized at the stone font.
example.zh: 这个婴儿是在石制洗礼盘旁接受洗礼的。

senses.en: relating to the anus (medical use)

example.en: The doctor explained the results of the anal examination.
example.zh: 医生解释了肛门检查的结果。

senses.en: (informal) excessively careful about small details and order
senses.zh: （非正式）过分拘谨的，吹毛求疵的

example.en: He is so anal about tidiness that he notices every misplaced pen.
example.zh: 他对整洁过分苛求，连放错位置的笔都会注意到。

senses.en: a small wingless insect that lives on the skin of people or animals and sucks blood

example.en: The child got head lice from a classmate.
example.zh: 这个孩子从同学那里染上了头虱。

senses.en: an unpleasant, dishonest person (informal)

example.en: He called his cheating business partner a louse.
example.zh: 他骂他那个欺诈的生意伙伴是个无赖。

senses.en: the back part of the neck

example.en: She felt a chill on the nape of her neck.
example.zh: 她感到后颈一阵发凉。

senses.en: the speaker or writer and one or more other people, as the object of a verb or preposition
senses.zh: 我们（第一人称复数宾格）

example.en: Please wait for us outside the station.
example.zh: 请在车站外面等我们。

senses.en: an approximate calculation or judgment of an amount, value, or cost

example.en: The builder gave us an estimate for the repairs.
example.zh: 建筑商给了我们维修的估价。

senses.en: to roughly calculate or judge an amount, value, or likely situation

example.en: They estimate the journey will take two hours.
example.zh: 他们估计这段旅程需要两个小时。

senses.en: a woman who serves food and drinks to customers in a restaurant

example.en: The waitress brought our menus right away.
example.zh: 女服务员马上把菜单端了过来。

senses.en: to work as a waitress in a restaurant
senses.zh: 当女服务员；做侍应工作

example.en: She waitressed at a restaurant all summer to earn money for college.
example.zh: 她整个夏天在一家餐馆当女服务员，挣上大学的钱。

senses.en: an adult male chicken (rooster)

example.en: The cock crows loudly every morning.
example.zh: 那只公鸡每天早晨都大声打鸣。

senses.en: to tilt or turn something upward or to one side

example.en: She cocked her head and listened carefully.
example.zh: 她歪着头，仔细倾听。

senses.en: to set the trigger of a gun ready for firing
senses.zh: 扳上（枪的）击锤；使处于待发状态

example.en: He cocked the gun carefully before aiming.
example.zh: 他瞄准前小心地扳上了枪的击锤。

senses.en: a tap or valve for controlling the flow of liquid

example.en: Turn the cock to stop the water flow.
example.zh: 转动旋塞以停止水流。

senses.en: a sudden strong feeling of fear or anxiety

example.en: She felt a moment of panic when she couldn't find her passport.
example.zh: 找不到护照时，她一时感到惊慌。

senses.en: sudden widespread fear among a group of people

example.en: The news caused panic among investors.
example.zh: 这一消息在投资者中引起了恐慌。

senses.en: to suddenly feel or cause a strong fear, often leading to uncontrolled behavior

example.en: Don't panic — we still have plenty of time.
example.zh: 别慌——我们还有很多时间。

senses.en: causing death

example.en: The crash was a fatal accident.
example.zh: 这场车祸是一起致命事故。

senses.en: having very serious or decisive consequences

example.en: A single mistake proved fatal to the company.
example.zh: 一个失误被证明对公司是毁灭性的。

senses.en: a heavy device dropped from a ship to keep it in place

example.en: The sailors dropped the anchor before the storm arrived.
example.zh: 水手们在暴风雨来临前抛下了锚。

senses.en: a person who presents a news program

example.en: She is the anchor of the evening news program.
example.zh: 她是晚间新闻节目的主播。

senses.en: to fix something firmly in place

example.en: They anchored the tent with heavy rocks.
example.zh: 他们用大石头把帐篷固定住。

senses.en: to moor a boat using an anchor

example.en: We anchored near the island for the night.
example.zh: 我们在岛附近抛锚过夜。

senses.en: a sharp pointed piece of metal; a sudden sharp increase in a value
senses.zh: 尖钉，尖状物；（数值的）激增

example.en: The chart showed a sharp spike in prices.
example.zh: 图表显示价格急剧飙升。

senses.en: to pierce with something sharp; to prevent something from happening

example.en: Rising costs spiked the company's plan to expand.
example.zh: 成本上涨使公司放弃扩张计划。

senses.en: to examine something very carefully and closely

example.en: The lawyer scrutinized every detail of the contract.
example.zh: 律师仔细审查了合同的每一个细节。

senses.en: to begin to grow or produce new shoots

example.en: New leaves sprouted on the branches in spring.
example.zh: 春天，树枝上长出了新叶。

senses.en: a new shoot or bud of a plant

example.en: Add bean sprouts to the stir-fry.
example.zh: 在炒菜里加点豆芽。

senses.en: very frightening

example.en: The horror movie was truly terrifying.
example.zh: 这部恐怖片真的很吓人。

senses.en: extremely large or intense

example.en: The car repairs cost a terrifying amount of money.
example.zh: 修车花了一大笔令人咋舌的钱。

senses.en: to make someone slightly angry; to irritate

example.en: The constant noise really annoys me.
example.zh: 持续不断的噪音真让我恼火。

senses.en: a heavy snowstorm with strong winds

example.en: The blizzard closed the roads for two days.
example.zh: 暴风雪使道路封闭了两天。

senses.en: to take things out of a bag, box, or suitcase
senses.zh: 打开（行李）取出物品；开箱

example.en: She unpacked her suitcase after the long flight.
example.zh: 长途飞行后，她打开行李箱取出物品。

senses.en: to analyze and explain something in detail

example.en: The teacher helped us unpack the meaning of the poem.
example.zh: 老师帮我们剖析了这首诗的含义。

senses.en: an amount that is enough for a purpose

example.en: The crop produced a sufficiency of food for the whole family.
example.zh: 收成足够全家食用。

senses.en: enough money or resources to live comfortably

example.en: He earned a modest sufficiency from his small shop.
example.zh: 他靠小店挣得一份还算宽裕的收入。

senses.en: in a way that causes harm or negative effects

example.en: The new policy could adversely affect small businesses.
example.zh: 新政策可能会对小企业产生不利影响。

senses.en: the state of being a famous performer or star

example.en: She rose to stardom after her first film.
example.zh: 她在第一部电影后一举成名。

senses.en: to flow back away from the land, as the tide does; to gradually decline

example.en: His enthusiasm began to ebb after weeks of setbacks.
example.zh: 连续数周的挫折之后，他的热情开始消退。

senses.en: the movement of the tide away from the shore; a gradual decline

example.en: The boat set out on the ebb.
example.zh: 小船趁退潮出发了。

senses.en: the study of how the mind processes and learns language

example.en: Psycholinguistics examines how children acquire their first language.
example.zh: 心理语言学研究儿童如何习得母语。

senses.en: to harm or injure someone or something

example.en: The storm scathed crops across the region.
example.zh: 暴风雨损害了该地区的庄稼。

senses.en: damage or harm

example.en: He escaped the accident without scathe.
example.zh: 他在事故中安然无恙。
